blocks.text: Match preview: Wellington face Auckland in 11th Match (ODI) on Sun, 8 Nov, 2026, 3:00 am at Basin Reserve Wellington. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Standard ODI surface expected. Conditions will be clearer at the toss — monitor team selection and dew factor for night games.
Expected par score: 250–290 runs par score.
Rain showers · High 22°C / Low 16°C · Rain: 3.7 mm · Wind: up to 12 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
